question: Which of the following Biosphere Reserves is located in Tamil Nadu?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Gulf of Mannar Biosphere Reserve**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Gulf of Mannar Biosphere Reserve** is located in the state of **Tamil Nadu**, India.
 
• It was established in **1989** and is one of the first biosphere reserves in India.
 
• The reserve covers an area of approximately **10,500 square kilometers** and includes 21 small islands and adjacent coral reefs.
 
• The Gulf of Mannar Biosphere Reserve is recognized for its **rich marine biodiversity**, including species of coral, fish, and sea turtles.
 
• This area is also home to **dugongs**, also known as sea cows, which are an endangered species.
 
• The reserve is part of the **Ramsar Convention**, which aims to conserve wetlands of international importance.
 
• It plays a crucial role in **protecting coastal ecosystems** and promoting sustainable development.
 
• The Gulf of Mannar Biosphere Reserve is famous for its **pearl banks**, which have been historically significant for pearl fishing.
 
• The reserve supports various livelihood activities such as **fishing, seaweed harvesting, and tourism.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Dibru-Saikhowa Biosphere Reserve**__

 __
 
• The **Dibru-Saikhowa Biosphere Reserve** is located in the state of **Assam**, India.
 
• It is primarily known for its **semi-evergreen forests** and grasslands.
 
• The reserve is home to a variety of **endangered species**, including the Bengal tiger, Gangetic dolphin, and clouded leopard.
 
• The reserve also hosts several migratory bird species, making it a popular **birdwatching destination.**
 
 
 
• **Seshachalam Biosphere Reserve**__
 __
 
• The **Seshachalam Biosphere Reserve** is located in **Andhra Pradesh**, India.
 
• It was designated as a biosphere reserve in **2010**.
 
• This reserve is notable for its **dry deciduous forests** and **red sanders trees**, which are endemic to this region.
 
• The area also has a significant religious importance due to the presence of the **Tirumala Hills**.
 
 
 
• **Sundarbans Biosphere Reserve**__
 
 
• The **Sundarbans Biosphere Reserve** is located in the state of **West Bengal**, India.
 
• It is part of the world's largest mangrove forest and is home to the iconic **Royal Bengal Tiger.**
 
• The Sundarbans have been recognized as a **UNESCO World Heritage Site**.
 
• The reserve is crucial for its **mangrove ecosystems**, which act as a protective barrier against cyclones and floods.
